info.title: shiny-bridge-sim — every Shiny.AppDeviceBridge bridge, simulated, with values you set and trails you play.
info.description: A terminal simulator for Shiny.AppDeviceBridge web apps: every bridge's endpoints answering with values you set, events you fire and trails you play (GPX walks included), with a traffic monitor — so a page can be tested against a device that does exactly what the test needs. Install with dotnet tool install -g Shiny.AppDeviceBridge.Simulator; run shiny-bridge-sim.

options.name: --app
options.description: serve a built web app (a published Blazor wwwroot, or any folder with index.html)

options.name: --dev-server
options.description: serve pages from a dev server (dotnet watch, Vite), on the bridges' origin

options.name: --port
options.description: loopback port (default 5299; 0 for any free port)

options.name: --platform
options.description: android | ios | maccatalyst | macos | windows | linux (default ios)

options.name: --app-id
options.description: the app id GET /_bridge/host reports (default simulator)

options.name: --scenario
options.description: apply a saved scenario on start

options.name: --trail
options.description: load a trail: .gpx (a GPS walk) or .trail.json; repeatable

options.name: --play
options.description: play a loaded trail on start; repeatable

options.name: --data
options.description: where the settings and files bridges keep data (default: a temp folder)

options.name: --headless
options.description: no TUI: serve, apply, play and log to the console
